commandCode: const fs=require('fs');const {performance}=require('perf_hooks');const line=JSON.stringify({event:'io_probe',body:'x'.repeat(480)})+'\n';for(let r=0;r<3;r++){for(const path of (r%2?['/windows','/native']:['/native','/windows'])){const fd=fs.openSync(path+'/probe-'+r+'.jsonl','w');const start=performance.now();for(let i=0;i<300;i++)fs.writeSync(fd,line);fs.closeSync(fd);console.log(JSON.stringify({path,repeat:r,writes:300,bytesPerWrite:Buffer.byteLength(line),elapsedMs:performance.now()-start}));}}
